name: Standing Wrist Extensor Stretch
steps: Stand or sit upright and extend your target arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Point your fingers downward toward the floor with your palm facing toward your body.
Use your opposite hand to grasp the back of your target hand near the knuckles.
Gently press the hand downward and backward toward your body until you feel a firm stretch across the top of your wrist and forearm.
Hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds with deep, relaxed breathing.
Release gently, then repeat on the opposite arm.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbow completely straight to place full stretch on the common extensor tendon.
Apply smooth, steady pressure without bouncing.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
